summary: CHAR-crowd-ensemble is registered as 'mixed animal/bird-coded background extras' for the ch006 kitchen lullaby chorus, but the source gives that chorus to the cook and the baby and places no one else in the kitchen.

source.quote: CHORUS. (In which the cook and the baby joined):
The only things in the kitchen that did not sneeze, were the cook, and a large cat

findings.issue: The 'CHORUS' speaker tag in structured_story is a song-structure label, not a separate group of people. Putting extra crowd performers in the Duchess's kitchen would conflict with the source.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop ch006 from CHAR-crowd-ensemble's appearances, or mark it as voice-only and attribute the chorus lines to CHAR-cook and the baby (with the Duchess). Keep the ensemble for ch004 only.

interim_handling: bible/characters/CHAR-crowd-ensemble/appearance.json designs an on-screen look for ch004 only and states that no crowd performer appears in the kitchen.
impact: Affects casting and blocking of the ch006 kitchen scene, and voice assignment for the ch006-p38/p42 chorus lines.
ruling: Source first: the ch006 'CHORUS' tag is a song-structure label. The source says 'In which the cook and the baby joined' (ch006-p37), and the only non-sneezers in the kitchen are the cook and the cat. No crowd is present in the kitchen, so the ensemble is ch004 only.
fix_instruction: bible/characters/index.json CHAR-crowd-ensemble: remove the ch006 entry from appearances and appearance_chapters. Rewrite performer_concept to cover only the ch004 onlookers outside the White Rabbit's house (drop the kitchen-lullaby clause). Update disambiguation/notes: the ch006 CHORUS lines (ch006-p38, p42) are sung by the Duchess with CHAR-cook and the baby joining (ch006-p37). Also set a concrete gender per DEF-p3-appearance-303-b. Tell the dialogue/voice owners (01-story/screenplay, 09-audio voice) about the chorus reattribution.
fix_note: bible/characters/index.json CHAR-crowd-ensemble: ch006 removed from appearances/appearance_chapters (ch004 only); performer_concept rewritten to drop the kitchen-lullaby clause; disambiguation and notes rewritten to state the ch006 CHORUS is sung by the Duchess with CHAR-cook and the Duchess's baby (ch006-p37); gender set to male with gender_mix {male:6,female:4} per DEF-p3-appearance-303-b. 01-story/screenplay and 09-audio/voice notified via qa/defects/DEF-p3-char-index-903.json. code/p3-char-index_check.py re-run: PASS.
